property_summary: After any actor deposits at least MinSum ether via Put with a future unlock time, an immediate Collect of up to the deposited amount must be a time-locked no-op leaving the actor's stored balance unchanged; the mutant never stores unlockTime, so the same Collect transfers funds and lowers the stored balance for some inputs.
change_summary: Delete the unlock-time assignment so the stored unlockTime is never updated by a Put call.
